pictures.author: Alekjds
pictures.observations: Whole960x324 panorama: broad front marble stair with rough central altar/remnant, four differently broken front shafts, raised roofless podium, rear cella masonry and very high bare ashlar firewall. Three tall fluted columns/short entablature plus attached pilaster stand at right; no restored full colonnade or roof.

pictures.author: NikonZ7II / Paris Orlando
pictures.observations: Whole960x673 front/side view: specific three tall white fluted Corinthian columns, leafy capitals and short entablature on right, attached pilaster, broken front shafts, wide stair and central rough remnant. Open grass-covered cella/podium, fragmentary rubble walls, tall rear ashlar firewall with a pale horizontal band; genuine round-arched Pantani opening at right. Modern houses and unrelated ruins remain host context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Mars Ultor temple remains: occupied raised podium and wide frontal stair with central rough altar remnant; four mapped broken front shafts, three tall mapped fluted Corinthian columns/short surviving entablature and rear pilaster; low fragmentary cella/apse masonry. Include mapped high rear firewall and lower right return with true round-arched Pantani passage. No restored complete roof, pediment, full colonnade, cult statues or copied sculpture/photo atlas. Independent neighboring houses and other Forum ruins remain native.
